title: Practise the interview
recap: Pipo helped you practise for the interview.
funFact: CV, email and interview practice: you're ready for your first job. Agents help you prepare; the job is all yours.
postcard: a student shaking hands with Bloom Café's owner, Pipo cheering: {answer}
situation: Bloom Café wants to meet you! Want to practise the interview?
facts: 🥐 They're known for pastries and oat lattes
💡 A short tip for each question
🗣️ You'll answer in your own words
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on a university student's phone. Help with what they ask. When you help someone practise, write one line per question.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Help me practise for my Bloom Café barista interview
pieces.text: Help me practise for my barista interview at Bloom Café.

pieces.label: They're known for pastries and oat lattes
pieces.text: Bloom Café is known for its pastries and oat lattes, so ask about those too.

pieces.label: A short tip for each
pieces.text: Add a short tip for each question, not a full answer.

pieces.label: 3 likely questions
pieces.text: Give me 3 questions they'll probably ask.

pieces.label: Write my answers so I can memorise them
pieces.text: Write my answers so I can memorise them.
pieces.tip: Memorised answers sound robotic. Tips help you answer in your own words.

flaws.hint: "An interview" doesn't say for what job.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know the job, so the questions aren't about being a barista.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo what Bloom Café is known for.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know about the pastries and oat lattes, so the practice is generic.

lesson: Ask Pipo for practice and tips, not a script. Your own words win interviews.
